corrections.field_01: Strongest feature: The argument identifies a chronologically extended Jerusalem succession tradition involving people remembered as physical relatives, supplying relevant corroborative material instead of relying exclusively on doctrinal inference. Principal limitation: Its categorical conclusion outruns the excerpt because a later transmitted ecclesiastical genealogy cannot independently authenticate every reported relationship or the historical person whose relatives the tradition presupposes. Live burden: The case must establish provenance, transmission reliability, informational independence, and resistance to institutional genealogy-making, while explaining why remembered kinship outweighs plausible legendary, honorific, or retrospective construction. Locked score: The assessment recognizes central relevance and a recoverable evidential proposition, yet preserves substantial reservations about unstable terminology, absent qualification, untested alternatives, and the inferential distance between remembered succession and demonstrated historicity.
corrections.field_02: Strongest feature: The move articulates a comparative challenge: resemblance between Jesus and suffering savior figures makes affirmative differentiation relevant, connecting the analogy to the central explanatory burden. Principal limitation: It converts broad motif resemblance into an unsupported presumptive rule without delimiting the comparison class, establishing a historical base rate, or confronting a mixed historical-and-mythic explanation. Live burden: The argument must demonstrate that selected parallels are independent, sufficiently specific, and historically probative, then explain why shared narrative features reduce historicity rather than reflecting development around a historical individual. Locked score: The assessment credits coherent relevance and a recoverable evidential demand while retaining reservations about evidential warrant, category stability, missing qualification, overstated necessity, and compressed treatment of the strongest alternative.
